text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to limit sugary drinks and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Third, get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to stay strong. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, relax, and take breaks when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. When work and rest are in harmony, you feel happier and more energetic. A healthy lifestyle is not difficult—small daily habits matter most.
